title: staging rebuild and status: invariant re-derivation
action: Subcommands `staging rebuild [--without <slug,...>]` and `staging status` per D0a trigger 3. rebuild: refuse when no staging record; in the staging worktree run git reset --hard main; recompute the awaiting-UAT set = staged features whose uat gate is unapproved (read the feature's workflow/lane record gates from main) AND whose branch still exists; drop the rest from staged[] (auto-drop on UAT pass/merge — the invariant re-derives); merge each remaining branch minus --without exclusions; per-feature conflict: abort that merge, typed STAGING_MERGE_CONFLICT naming the feature, CONTINUE with the rest, report all conflicts at the end; update base_sha; run commands.staging_build when present. status: staged set with each feature's uat gate state, plus stale-base warning when base_sha != current main sha (the trigger-3 reminder). Tests: rebuild resets to new main and re-merges only unapproved-gate features; --without excludes; UAT-approved feature auto-drops; one conflicting feature does not block the others; status reports stale base.

truths: rebuild = reset --hard main + re-merge awaiting-UAT features
one conflict never blocks the remaining features
